summary: Zhibao Technology Inc., a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed insurance brokerage, furnished a Form 6-K containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled September 29, 2026, in Shanghai and virtually. Shareholders will vote on increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$200,000 via creation of 1,500,000,000 additional Class A ordinary shares, adopting amended articles, and a contingent 1-for-50 share consolidation triggered if the Class A closing bid falls below US$0.12. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a deal is stated; this is a routine EGM/proxy notice, not a special situation.
